info.title: Acclimate content service
info.description: Acclimate content service: versioned agent bundles, channels and releases, paired comparisons, evaluation requests run by application-owned evaluators, and connected learning. This document is the source of truth for routes, fields, status codes and error codes. Compatibility and deprecation rules are in the versioning and compatibility reference.

get.summary: Inspect the connection’s delivery and private development incumbent

put.summary: Authorize automatic rollout for a connection
put.description: A signed-in workspace administrator enrolls this connection with committed development and independent audit cases. Passing learning rounds release automatically.

get.description: Chronological created_at/id keyset pagination. Pass the scoped nextCursor returned by the preceding page.

post.description: Abandon a requested or running attempt whose outcome is unknown, such as a cancelled CI job. Requires `evaluate` (or a workspace editor). The attempt's later reports are refused, promotion rejects comparisons bound to it, and a new request for the same candidate may start. It never claims the original worker stopped. Connected-learning requests return `managed_evaluation`.

get.description: Setup/draft lookup by key or route lookup by canonical operationPath. Rechecks effective current action authority before returning a result.

post.description: Existing commit wins; otherwise fence the matching global or route-scoped identity. Repeatable; late marked and unmarked writes cannot pass the fence.

get.description: Read visible failed or indeterminate policy verdicts for the candidate version.
Newest 200 machine tokens. Secrets are never returned. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

post.description: Issue an expiring machine token. The secret is returned once and stored only as a SHA-256 digest. Its principal is `machine:{name}`. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

Issue a successor with the same principal and rights. With `overlapSeconds` 0 the old token is revoked; otherwise its expiry is shortened to the overlap. Only an active token can be rotated (`machine_token_inactive`). Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.
Revoke a token. Idempotent; the first reason is retained. Applies to the token's next request. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

get.description: Newest 200 entries of the append-only token audit trail. Requires a browser session for a workspace administrator; machine tokens cannot manage tokens.

status.description: Evaluated means the comparison was submitted and the worker decision is pending. Completed includes calibration statistics, the repetition plan and power projections. A power guard rejection publishes those fields with stopped and stoppedReason.

developmentRepetitions.description: Assigned repetitions per development case, shared with cumulative comparisons. New plans use equal counts for unscheduled inventories.

auditRepetitions.description: Uniform count per unscheduled audit cohort in enrollment order. Earlier plans recorded a repetition floor.

flakyCaseCount.description: Development cases with observed A/A disagreement.

pairBudget.description: Pair budget per evaluation before the report size limit.

trialBudget.description: Twice the pair budget, before retries.

maxRepetitions.description: Cap on the planned uniform repetition count.

components.description: Optional named numeric grade components on a scored outcome, such as correctness. A quality policy can gate on one with metric.component. Omitted when the grader reports none.

parentSourceComparisonId.description: Source comparison for a cached development parent arm. Omitted for fresh pairs.
Source comparison for a cached development parent arm. Omitted for fresh pairs.

details.description: Optional typed metadata, never credential secrets. credential_already_issued carries credentialId, kind and revokedAt.

requireBoundEvidence.description: Completing an evaluation requires a comparison bound to its request and attempt.

runName.description: The evaluator's label for this run, such as the CLI --name. Display only. Omitted when unset.

retryOf.description: An earlier request on the same parent and candidate content that this run supersedes. Omitted when unset.

policyDigest.description: Digest of the quality policy chosen before the run. Policy receipts record whether they match it.

inference.description: Statistics behind the mean-difference check as reported by the SDK verdict: method, estimand, confidence, n, sd, sdFloor, df, criticalValue, lowerBound, threshold and imputed counts. At most 4096 bytes.

policyPin.description: Whether the receipt's policy digest matches the one pinned on the evaluation request.

secretPrefix.description: First 12 characters of the secret, for identification.

lastUsedAt.description: Coarse; updated at most once a minute.

secret.description: Returned once. Never stored or listed.

previous.description: Rotation only: the predecessor after its revocation or shortened expiry.

EvaluationCapabilities.description: Point-in-time authority for a machine principal, not a lease or provider readiness.

writeEvaluation.description: True when the principal holds `evaluate` (implied by `write`).

runLabels.description: Evaluation requests accept runName and retryOf. Absent on older services.

policyPins.description: Evaluation requests accept policyDigest, pinning the quality policy before the run. Absent on older services.

EvaluationDescriptor.description: Public evaluator identity: revisions, runtime identity and the fixed case inventory. Case inputs, expected answers, callbacks and credentials never appear here.

EvaluationHandoff.description: The handoff file the console downloads as handoff.json for an evaluation request. The evaluator CLI's request command writes it and --handoff reads it. It names the evaluation request and its frozen descriptor. It carries no credential or private path.
